libXmu 1.2.1 - X miscellaneous utility library

Source: https://www.x.org/releases/individual/lib/libXmu-1.2.1.tar.xz
Tarball: references/_tarballs/libXmu-1.2.1.tar.xz
Extracted to: references/libXmu-1.2.1/ (read-only reference copy)
Copied into third-party/: src/, include/, COPYING (unmodified).

License: MIT/X11 (see COPYING).

Build: driven by third-party/libXmu/CMakeLists.txt, not the upstream
autotools. We only build the libXmu variant (depends on Xt); the
libXmuu subset (Xlib-only) is not exposed as its own target since
nothing in em-x11 links against it separately.

libXmu exists because libXaw pulls in ~10 Xmu headers for resource
converters, atom helpers, and drawing primitives. No direct em-x11
client uses Xmu.

Upgrade procedure: replace references/_tarballs/libXmu-*.tar.xz,
re-extract into references/, diff against third-party/libXmu/ to
pick up local patches, then re-copy src/ and include/.
